client: Hi Luna, I've been really struggling lately. I recently found out I have a chronic illness, and it's just been overwhelming. I keep thinking about all the things that might go wrong, and I'm not sure how to cope with this new reality. I'm not even sure if therapy can really help with something like this.
therapist: Hi there, I can hear how heavy this news has been for you, and it’s completely understandable to feel overwhelmed and uncertain about the future. It’s natural to have these worries, but I’m here to support you through this journey, and we can explore ways to manage your thoughts and find some coping strategies together.
vocal_descriptors: very high pitch, soft-spoken, moderate-paced speech

therapist: I can hear the depth of your worry and the strain it’s putting on you. It’s completely understandable to feel this way, and it’s okay to take your time to process these feelings.
